title: Request-Response modifier plugins
description:
Enterprise only. Inject your own Go request and response modifier plugins.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/plugin-modifiers/

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description:
The list of plugins to load, each one with its own configuration.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/plugin-modifiers/

plugin.title: Plugin
plugin.description:
A plugin to load and its configuration.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/plugin-modifiers/

config.title: Plugin configuration
config.description:
The configuration passed to the plugin. Its content depends on each plugin.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/plugin-modifiers/

name.title: Plugin name
name.description:
The name of the plugin to load. It must match the name your plugin registers.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/plugin-modifiers/
